const kbArticles = [
  {
    title: "Order Tracking and Shipping",
    category: "e-commerce",
    content: `Customers can track an order from the Order History section of their TechSupport Pro account. 
After an order ships, the tracking number is displayed in the order details and the customer can use it to follow the shipment.
Standard shipping normally takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. 
If tracking information has not updated for several business days, the customer should contact support for assistance.
TechSupport Pro support cannot change the delivery address after an order has been shipped.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro Support Policy - Order Tracking"
  },

  {
    title: "Returns and Refunds",
    category: "e-commerce",
    content: `Eligible products may be returned within 30 days of delivery when they are in unused and resalable condition.
Customers should contact support to start a return request and provide the order number.
Refunds are processed after the returned item is received and inspected.
The original payment method is used for approved refunds.
Account-specific refund status and exceptions require human support review.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro Support Policy - Returns and Refunds"
  },

  {
    title: "Password Reset",
    category: "saas",
    content: `Customers who forget their TechSupport Pro password can select "Forgot Password" on the sign-in page.
A password-reset email is then sent to the email address associated with the account.
The reset link should be used promptly and a new password should be created.
If the customer does not receive the reset email, they should check spam or junk folders.
Account ownership and identity verification issues must be handled by human support.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro SaaS Guide - Password Reset"
  },

  {
    title: "Troubleshooting Application Access",
    category: "saas",
    content: `If the TechSupport Pro application is not loading, customers should first verify their internet connection and refresh the application.
They should also try signing out and signing back in.
If the problem continues, the customer should record the error message and contact support.
Support may need to investigate account-specific access problems or service incidents.
The automated support agent must not claim that an outage exists unless the knowledge base explicitly confirms it.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro SaaS Guide - Application Troubleshooting"
  },

  {
    title: "Course Enrollment",
    category: "education",
    content: `Customers can enroll in available TechSupport Pro training courses through the Courses section of the platform.
Course availability and enrollment requirements are shown on the course information page.
If a course requires approval or has restricted enrollment, the request must be reviewed by the appropriate human administrator.
Questions involving a specific student's enrollment record require human support.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro Education Policy - Course Enrollment"
  },

  {
    title: "Healthcare Administrative Support",
    category: "healthcare",
    content: `TechSupport Pro may provide general administrative information about supported healthcare services, scheduling processes, and account procedures.
The support agent must not provide medical advice, diagnosis, treatment recommendations, or interpretations of medical results.
Questions involving a customer's personal medical information or specific healthcare case must be routed to human support.
Sensitive account or patient information should not be exposed in automated responses.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro Healthcare Administrative Policy"
  },

  {
    title: "Banking Product and Policy Information",
    category: "banking",
    content: `TechSupport Pro support can provide general information about supported banking products and published policies.
The automated agent must not provide individualized financial advice.
Questions involving a specific customer's account balance, transaction, payment dispute, identity verification, or other sensitive account information must be routed to human support.
When a policy does not clearly answer a question, the agent should not guess and should request human review.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro Banking General Policy"
  },

  {
    title: "When Human Support Is Required",
    category: "general",
    content: `Human support is required when a customer question cannot be answered confidently from the available TechSupport Pro knowledge base.
Account-specific, sensitive, confidential, disputed, or exceptional cases should be routed to a human.
If the knowledge base only partially answers a question, the response should be marked for human review.
If the knowledge base contains insufficient information, the automated agent must not invent an answer.
Automated responses should remain grounded in the retrieved knowledge-base content.`,
    source: "TechSupport Pro Support Escalation Policy"
  }
];

return kbArticles.map(article => ({
  json: article
}));
